sloka: एते तिष्ठन्तु गच्छामो भर्ता नो यत्र वानरः ।सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः सह रामेण तिष्ठति ।। ५.६२.३१ ।।।।
transliteration: ete tiṣṭhantu gacchāmo bhartā no yatra vānaraḥ ।sugrīvo vipulagrīvaḥ saha rāmeṇa tiṣṭhati ।। 5.62.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "Let them stay here. Our broadnecked king Sugriva will be there with Rama. Let us go to him.
